address: The Mansion, Bletchley Park, Sherwood Dr, Bletchley, Milton Keynes ,MK3 6EB
bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the epicentre of one of Britain's most historically exciting locations - Bletchley Park. Afternoon Tea price includes admission to park. Previously shrouded in secrecy to protect the nation's secrets, code breaking and developing technology defines Bletchley Park as it is the home of British intelligence. It is now open to visitors seven days a week, and enjoyed over 286,000 last year alone. It marries together the dramatic history of the twentieth century, with the challenges we face today. Visitors can explore experience and enjoy the top-secret world of iconic World War 2 Codebreaking Huts and Blocks set within its atmospheric Victorian estate. Reinvigorate yourself with Afternoon Tea, which is served in the dining room in the newly launched Mansion House. All food is created on site, with local ingredients. All the pastries and cakes are made daily by the passionate team of chefs. Located in Milton Keynes, Bletchley Park is opposite Bletchley railway station.
